question: Should OpenClaw add a native companion-app ASR/STT provider boundary for this request, and if so should it route through tools.media.audio, Talk transcription providers, or a new native-only endpoint setting?
rationale: The source shows the requested behavior is missing, but implementing it safely requires product and security choices about platform scope, provider ownership, credentials, private-network access, and fallback semantics that automation should not decide.

options.title: Design a shared native STT boundary
options.body: Adopt a cross-surface plan that keeps platform speech as default and bridges native capture to existing media or Talk provider contracts where maintainers choose.

options.title: Narrow to macOS Push-to-Talk first
options.body: Use the narrower macOS PTT issue as the first scoped implementation target and leave wake/mobile/browser behavior for later design.

options.title: Keep ASR customization outside native apps
options.body: Decline a native setting and direct users to tools.media.audio, realtime transcription plugins, or external wrappers until a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Design a shared native STT boundary
recommendation.body: Adopt a cross-surface plan that keeps platform speech as default and bridges native capture to existing media or Talk provider contracts where maintainers choose.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for the native macOS voice paths is steipete, and this request starts from macOS Apple Speech behavior.
